title: 18beta-Glycyrrhetinic acid ameliorates renal anemia via inactivating PHD2 and activating HIF-2alpha-EPO axis.
authors: Li, Jiaxuan; Han, Kai; Fu, Yuhan; Zhao, Chong; Yin, Shutao; Hu, Hongbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草酸代谢物GA通过分子对接抑制PHD2并激活HIF-2α-EPO通路改善肾性贫血，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: 18beta-Glycyrrhetinic acid (GA) is a major metabolite of glycyrrhizin (GL) that is a key ingredient of licorice, a popular edible and medicinal plant, and is often used in the food and pharmaceutical industry as a flavoring agent. Previous studies suggest that licorice possess hematopoietic activity. However, the bioactive ingredients in licorice that produce hematopoietic effect remain elusive. This study aimed to test if GA is the key active molecule that contributed to the anti-anemia activity of licorice. Both in vivo and in vitro models were utilized to determine the efficacy of GA against renal anemia and to decipher its related mechanisms. We found for the first time that oral administration of GA at clinically safe doses is effective against renal anemia, illustrated by the improvement in key hematological parameters. Mechanistically, GA was found to be able to directly bind to and inhibit PHD2, analyzed by molecular docking simulation, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and a time-resolved fluorescence resonance energy transfer (TR-FRET)-based enzyme activity assay. PHD2 inactivation by GA led to the activation of HIF-2alpha-erythropoietin (EPO) pathway, accompanied by improved iron availability and inhibition of inflammation. Further, the tissue distribution analysis revealed that the concentrations of GA in target organ kidney and liver are 120.39 and 83.86 mug/g respectively, exceeding IC50 of 18.83 mug/mL for inhibition of PHD2. The findings therefore identified GA as a novel HIF-PHD2 inhibitor with favorable target tissue distribution that contributed to the anti-anemia effect of licorice and warrants further investigation.
abstract_zh: 18β-甘草次酸（GA）是甘草酸（GL）的主要代谢产物，甘草酸是甘草（一种广受欢迎的可食用及药用植物）的关键成分，常在食品和制药工业中用作调味剂。既往研究表明甘草具有造血活性。然而，甘草中产生造血效应的生物活性成分仍不明确。本研究旨在测试GA是否为甘草抗贫血活性的关键活性分子。采用体内和体外模型来确定GA对肾性贫血的疗效，并阐明其相关机制。我们首次发现，以临床安全剂量口服GA对肾性贫血有效，表现为关键血液学参数的改善。机制上，通过分子对接模拟、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）以及基于时间分辨荧光共振能量转移（TR-FRET）的酶活性测定分析发现，GA能够直接结合并抑制PHD2。GA对PHD2的失活导致HIF-2α-促红细胞生成素（EPO）通路的激活，同时伴随铁可用性的改善和炎症的抑制。此外，组织分布分析显示，GA在靶器官肾脏和肝脏中的浓度分别为120.39和83.86 μg/g，超过了对PHD2抑制的IC50值18.83 μg/mL。因此，这些发现将GA鉴定为一种新型HIF-PHD2抑制剂，具有有利的靶组织分布，这有助于甘草的抗贫血作用，并值得进一步研究。
